notes.title: 💀 The Biggest Manual Samuel Update Yet – Out Now! 💀
notes.content:
Hey, manual breathers! 

The wait is over, our biggest update ever for Manual Samuel is here! We’ve overhauled the game with tons of quality-of-life improvements, bug fixes, and brand-new features to make Samuel’s awkward adventure even smoother (and weirder). 

We’ve also given Manual Samuel a technical facelift with a massive engine upgrade, better visuals, improved animations, and a brand-new audio system. The game now runs in borderless fullscreen, supports ultra-wide resolutions, and features better controller support. Oh, and did we mention? Some grandmas are now gangsters, coffee stains are actually a thing, and the dog? Better than ever.

Check out the full list of changes below: 

[h3][b]Gameplay & Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b][/h3]

- Overhauled the game to fix numerous bugs and enhance the overall experience.
- Made on-screen hints less intrusive, with some removed due to gameplay tweaks.
- Improved tutorial sequences, especially for breathing and driving.
- Refined the Satan fight and made hell’s demons slightly easier to deal with.
- Completely replaced the old achievement and leaderboard system.
- Added 8 brand-new achievements.
- Improved the UI for high-resolution screens and added ultra-wide support.
- New controller layout screen in the pause menu, plus better default keyboard controls, AZERTY support, and meme layouts.
- Snappier and more intuitive main menu navigation.
- Renamed "Time Attack" to "Trials", with two new game modes:
- Speedrun Mode – Race through the game as fast as possible.
- Challenge Mode – Complete special challenges during your run.
- Leaderboards now display the top 10 players in each category. 

[h3][b]Technical & Visual Upgrades[/b][/h3]

- Updated the engine from Unity 5.6 to Unity 2022.3.57, improving performance and extending the game’s lifespan.
- Switched to FMOD for improved audio and added new sound effects.
- Enhanced animations, upgraded text rendering, and improved character visuals.
- Rebuilt the particle system and introduced a new camera system with smoother transitions and better shakes.
- Upscaled low-resolution assets to look sharper on modern screens.
- Replaced deprecated localization and sprite rendering systems with native Unity solutions. 

[h3][b]New (and totally necessary) Features[/b][/h3]

- Borderless fullscreen mode for a smoother experience.
- 64-bit support for Windows and Intel64 + Silicon support for Mac.
- Gangster grandmas (because why not?).
- Better dog—he’s just objectively improved.
- Revolutionary hair-dyeing mechanics.
- Game-changing coffee stain physics.
- Independent coffee cups, no longer bound to Samuel’s hands.
- Enhanced controller vibration feedback for more immersive suffering. 

This update is available now, so get ready to stumble, breathe, and blink your way through Manual Samuel like never before!

Stay manual,
Perfectly Paranormal

notes.title: Manual Samuel Anniversary Edition
notes.content:
Hello fellow videogame enthusiasts!
On this very day 4 years ago (and 42 days) the world changed forever. We're pleased to announce that today it will change once more.

We present to you the Manual Samuel Anniversary Edition (Almost)!

The game has recieved a long overdue overhaul, as well as some additional content and features - like amazing comics and global leaderboards!
We have also made a certain bossfight make a little more sense from a game design perspective, which means that it is a bit shorter and a bit easier. 


We realize that this will create a new speedrunning category, so in order to preserve the old category we have decided to keep the old version on a beta branch in Steam: 
Just open properties, go to betas and select 'classic'.
We have tried to make the speedrunning experience more rewarding by implementing Steam leaderboards into the game, 
this includes both the time attack levels and the game as a whole, additionally we have added an in-game timer you can enable in the options menu.

Here is a ridiculously overproduced trailer to mark the anniversary (almost), and a full list of changes below:

[previewyoutube=RNO19zafdA0;full]<trailer>[/previewyoutube]

Changes:
[list]
[*] Each time attack level now has a global leaderboard
[*] Added a global leaderboard for speedruns, also added an option to show the timer while playing
[*] Death4Life comics are available to read in the main menu in both English and Japanese
[*] Added Japanese localization
[*] The game now saves data based on steam user ID, multiple users on the same computer will no longer have to share save files. Files saved in the old location are still kept and synced with the cloud to make the transition smooth.
[*] Reduced size on disk from approximately 2gb to 500mb
[*] The main menu has gotten a small overhaul
[*] Satan fight is slightly easier
[*] Playing with keyboard should now work 100% even if you have a controller plugged in
[*] Button prompts now update to reflect the last used controller
[*] Improved kickflip animation
[*] Increased texture resolution of most of the characters in the game
[*] Car clutch sensitivity has been increased to compensate for inaccurate controllers
[*] Added in-game achievement view
[*] Fixed exploit and potential crash bug where you could skip Death vomiting sequences by pausing/unpausing in Sam Blasts level
[*] Fixed issue where Death's vomit would sometimes hang in the air and not fall. (A truly immersion-breaking experience)
[*] Fixed issue where interrupting the robots aggro animation by shooting at them, would cause them to not aim correctly when shooting at you.
[*] Updated input system to the latest version, this should hopefully take care of some controller-detection issues people have been experiencing
[*] Updated Fabric Audio to latest version
[*] Fixed an issue where pausing the game during the intro section of a music track would make the track start the loop section too early when unpausing, causing overlapping music
[*] Sam actually takes a leak on the towels
[*] Sam actually takes a leak on the floor
[*] Sam actually takes a leak everywhere, including, but not limited to, himself
[*] A number of character animations has been improved, some characters are now less floaty
[*] Added small background details to tie the game further with Helheim Hassle
[*] A bunch of other fixes that was backported from the Switch version
[/list]

notes.title: HELHEIM HASSLE IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
In Helheim Hassle, the sequel to Manual Samuel, you get to:

[list]
[*] Die and be resurrected yet again!
[*] Attach and detach limbs to solve puzzles.
[*] Meet a cast of over 80 characters in the ever growing Perfectly Paranormal universe.
[*] Have a brand new skeleton sidekick!
[/list]

Check out Helheim Hassle's Release trailer down below!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vSsRm1NFzDA

Helheim Hassle is a narrative adventure game that is as much about friendship as it is about body parts. From the same universe (and set on the same Tuesday, in fact) as previous hit Manual Samuel, comes this macabre adventure where you play as Bjørn, a pacifist viking who hates the idea of dying and going to Valhalla… who then ends up dying and getting taken to Valhalla. When Bjørn is resurrected to assist with a task for the mysterious Pesto, he sees a way to negotiate his way out. Using Bjørn’s undying corpse with its ability to detach and combine limbs at will, players must solve challenging puzzles and navigate tricky levels in order to retrieve a certain magical item... In return, Pesto will try to grant Bjørn a permanent residence in Helheim - what a hassle!

Purchase it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1095120/Helheim_Hassle/

notes.title: Patch is Live!
notes.content:
A patch has been released, which should hopefully address the issues many of you have been experiencing. The fixes are as follows.

[b]Input[/b]

Any available controller should now be assigned to the player when starting the game.

Updated input plugin to latest version.

Alternative keys have been added for keyboard users:

[list]
[*]Left Arrow = Left Leg

[*]Right Arrow = Right Leg

[*]Up Arrow = Spine

[*]Down Arrow = Turn

[*], = Breathe in

[*]. = Breathe out

[*]Space = Blink

[*]H = Head
[/list]


[b]Gameplay[/b]

Changed clutch mechanic to respond when button is 90% pressed.

Made Death less annoying in car section.

Small animation fixes for Death in car section.

Made MaidBot slightly easier to kill.

Made a certain last boss less frustrating.

Told Death to tone down the kickflip comments in the basement.

Fixed a door. Clever boy.

Text updates.
